title: LayoutPack Command
description: Create landscape Layout pages on A4, A3, A2 or A1 (A3 by default). Each page has one parallel Detail of the greyscale HiddenLineDrawing on S-DRAW and a title block at the bottom-right. The plan drawing is a cut 1200 mm above the floor.

paper.description: Landscape paper for the whole set. Omit to keep the paper kept on the file (A3 when none). A named paper is kept for the next Print.

views.description: Pages to lay out, in order. Default plan, north, east, south, west, every stored section, schedules. schedules is its own A3 page (Forsk — Schedules) with the door, window and room lists from the model; each door and window gets a stable mark (forsk:mark D01, V01) shown on the plan and on its row. export_pdf draws the lists again from the model. section_<letter> is a section stored by section_add (Forsk — Section A): its own sheet, and its marker A–A on the plan. detail_<scale>_<n> is the n-th detail sheet at 1:scale (Forsk — Details 1:20): the drawings of the details stored by details add, at their own scale.

scale.description: Requested detail scale denominator. 100 means 1:100. Rounded up to a standard step if the drawing does not fit the detail. Omit to fit: the plan takes the largest scale that fits, elevations 1:100.

replace.description: Delete existing Forsk Layout pages for those views before creating them.

include_existing.description: Include X-EXIST in the greyscale drawing.

schedule_kinds.description: Which lists the schedules page shows. Default door, window, room.

set.description: Which set: sheets (default) or analysis, the Analysis set's own sheets (A-80-00n: daylight per room, areas; A-80-101: the plan with the daylight map). With no views, lays out the analyses in the Analysis set.
